claims.evidence: Witness photos show an Xbox console with an Xbox logo and a controller, but do not show the console model (Series X vs One vs other) or a visible list of installed games.

claims.claim: Games include Fc 26, far cry 3, modern warfare 3, dishonored 2 and tomb...
claims.evidence: Witness photos show the monitor displaying “EA SPORTS FC 25” (not FC 26) and a football game; no photo shows the full installed-games list.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No photo shows seals/opening history; witness only reports external appearance and setup.
Photos show cables connected and a working display at the time of viewing, but do not test all ports or overheating behavior.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a controller, but do not show “original pads” (what exactly) or any receipt.

risks.risk: Console model mismatch (Series X vs One vs other) and storage size unknown; pricing depends heavily on exact model and capacity.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the console model label (back/bottom) showing exact model and storage, plus a settings screen showing storage capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as an older/unknown Xbox model with unknown storage and no confirmed accessories beyond what is visible.

risks.risk: Installed games claim may be wrong or incomplete; also FC version mismatch (witness shows FC 25, seller says FC 26).
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of the Xbox “My games & apps” library showing the installed titles and versions.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + controller only, with games not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Controller condition unknown (stick drift, button responsiveness, battery/charging status).
risks.proof: A short clip showing controller connected and responding in-game (moving camera/character, pressing all buttons) plus battery/charging indicator.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as controller may need repair/replacement (reduced value).

risks.risk: Monitor specs and health unknown (size/inches, resolution/refresh rate, dead pixels, brightness/contrast issues).
risks.proof: A photo of the monitor model/spec label and a dead-pixel test screen (or close-up of settings showing resolution/refresh rate).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as a basic/unknown-spec monitor with potential display issues.

risks.risk: Port functionality not fully verified (HDMI ports, USB ports, audio, power, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth).
risks.proof: A clip showing multiple ports in use (e.g., HDMI output to TV/monitor, USB device connected, headset/audio test) and a settings screen confirming Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested ports (discounted).

risks.risk: Accessories/contents not confirmed (HDMI cable, power cable, headset, original box, receipt).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of every included item with cables and receipt visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal included items only (console + controller + monitor as shown), no extra accessories.

proof_requests: Photo of the Xbox console model label (exact model) and storage capacity (settings screen).
Screenshot/photo of “My games & apps” showing all installed games (and versions).
Video clip of the controller being tested: all buttons, both sticks, triggers, D-pad, and battery/charging status.
Photo of the monitor model/spec label (inches, resolution, refresh rate) and a dead-pixel/brightness test screen.
Video showing multiple ports working (HDMI, USB, audio/headset if applicable) and Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth status in settings.
Photo of all included accessories and the UK receipt (receipt clearly readable).
response.reason: The witness confirms a Dell monitor, an Xbox console, and an Xbox-style controller are present and powered to a game screen, but key details that determine the correct worst-case price (exact console model/storage, monitor specs, controller condition, and confirmed included items/games) are not shown. Without those missing shots, a reliable price cannot be set.
